q: What is a 'skill' in Hermes Agent?
options: A stored, reusable procedure the agent follows to do a task consistently
explanation: A skill is a stored procedure — how to do a recurring task — so you don't re-teach the agent each time.

q: Why is 'progressive disclosure' good for low bandwidth?
options: It shows every skill in full every time
A light skill index loads by default; full detail is pulled only when a skill is invoked, keeping sessions lean
It downloads all skills at startup
explanation: Progressive disclosure loads a light index by default and pulls full skill detail only when needed, keeping sessions small and fast.

q: A good first skill to save for a professional is:
options: A skill that auto-sends emails without approval
A fixed-format daily briefing as a reusable procedure
A skill that re-installs your OS
A skill that logs into your bank
explanation: A fixed-format daily/weekly briefing is the classic first skill and saves real time every day.
